title: IRF referral stated only in the case management note with a blank disposition hint; summary signed 31 days after discharge (boundary, fail); stroke; no quality data shared

rationale.disposition: EDGE: the disposition hint is blank and the summary has no disposition section; the case management note states discharge to an inpatient rehabilitation facility (IRF), which this rule accepts.
rationale.pac_list: EDGE: the IRF referral appears only in the case management note, but it is still a post-acute referral, so the pac rules apply; the Medicare-participating IRF list is documented.
rationale.pac_choice: Patient and wife were told they could choose any listed facility and chose Cedar Ridge.
rationale.pac_quality_data: PLANTED GAP: no quality or resource-use data (for example Care Compare ratings) was shared; the choice was based on distance only.
rationale.timeliness: EDGE (boundary): discharged 2026-10-12 and signed 2026-11-12, 31 days later, one day past the 30-day limit.
rationale.info_transmitted: Sent electronically to the PCP and the rehabilitation facility on 2026-11-12 (late, but sent).
rationale.goals_of_care: Code status and the stated goal of returning home and driving are documented.
rationale.meds_consistent: Both lists contain the same five medications; aspirin is mentioned in nursing only as a medication not to take, matching its stopped status in the summary.
